rationale: check_latex matches the exact TeX control word and checks the immediately preceding opening brace and immediately following ASCII space in raw source. The tests distinguish longer control words, reject tabs/newlines/nonbreaking spaces and intervening text, and count diagnostic lines across Unicode and CRLF. The integration test recursively scans all Markdown, independent of the table of contents, and process_with_roots applies the same lint before rendering even literal TeX samples. This implements the stated adjacency convention; it neither parses balanced TeX groups nor checks the meaning of the overbar.
